info.longBusinessSummary: GigaCloud Technology Inc. provides end-to-end B2B ecommerce solutions for large parcel merchandise in the United States and internationally. The company offers GigaCloud Marketplace that integrates product discovery to payments and logistics tools into one easy-to-use platform. It's marketplace connects manufacturers primarily in Asia with resellers in the United States, Asia, and Europe to execute cross-border transactions across furniture, home appliance, fitness equipment, and other large parcel categories. The company was formerly known as Oriental Standard Human Resources Holdings Limited and changed its name to GigaCloud Technology Inc. in February 2021. GigaCloud Technology Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in El Monte, California.

rationale.growth: Years 1–2 from analyst consensus (3 analysts: 26.8%, 8.1%); then a straight-line fade to 2.5% terminal growth by year 7.
rationale.ebit_margin: Starts at last year's EBIT margin (12.5%) and moves to the 4-year median (12.3%) over 5 years.
rationale.tax: Median effective tax rate (16.5%), kept within 15–30%.
rationale.reinvestment: Historical medians: D&A 0.5%, capex 0.6% of revenue; working capital 7.3% of revenue, so each extra $1 of sales ties up $0.07. Stock-based compensation (0.9% of revenue) is treated as a cash cost. IFRS reporters: lease payments sit in financing cash flow, so check capex covers them.
rationale.wacc: CAPM: risk-free 5.15% (US 10-year Treasury yield (CBOE ^TNX via Yahoo Finance)) + adjusted beta 1.41 × ERP 5.0% + small-cap premium 1.0% = cost of equity 13.19%. Pre-tax cost of debt 6.15% (interest ÷ debt). Market-value weights: debt 16.5%.
rationale.exit_multiple: Median peer EV/EBITDA (20.3x) as a cross-check terminal value.
